description: This power represents hydrological features: meandering river deltas, deep glacial fjords, inland freshwater lakes, mist-shrouded fenlands, barrier coral reefs, and thundering waterfalls.
fantasticalDescription: This power represents fantastical watery phenomena: luminous celestial rivers flowing through the sky, eternal whirlpool maelstroms leading to the hollow core, living tidal pools, and reverse cataracts falling into the clouds.
examples: Glacial Fjords, Braided River Estuaries, Crater Lakes, Turquoise Barrier Reefs, Tidal Mangroves, and Abyssal Ocean Trenches.
creativePrompts: Where do the headwaters spring from, and how do they sustain future civilizations?
What creatures or spirits inhabit the deepest, sunless trenches of this body of water?
Does this waterway unite distinct regions via easy travel, or does its treacherous current isolate them?
exampleNarratives: A life-giving river carved a winding silver ribbon across the plains, emptying through a fertile braided delta.
Sheer granite sea-cliffs dropped thousands of feet into a freezing indigo fjord, sheltered from the howling outer ocean.
A radiant barrier of living coral formed a turquoise lagoon where warm waters nursed nascent marine life.
